 Duke is the favorite for Serbian hoops star
 By ADAM ZAGORIA 
 Duke has emerged as the favorite for Serbian basketball star Matija Lukić , multiple sources told ZAGSBLOG.
 The 6-foot-9, 17-year-old wing recently visited Duke along with Boston College, BYU, N.C. State, North Carolina, UConn and Utah.
 Matija Lukic is an international name to know.
The 6-7 Serbian wing averaged 16.1 PPG, 4.4 RPG and 2.4 APG on 41.9% from three at the 2026 FIBA U17 World Cup.
The 17 year old is expected to play college basketball next season and is nearing a decision between Duke, UConn and UNC — with Duke emerging as the current favorite.
— Travis Branham (@TravisBranham_) November 16, 2026 
 Lukić was named MVP of the NBA’s Basketball Without Borders Next Up camp and averaged 16.1 points for Serbia’s silver-medal team at the FIBA U17 World Cup.
 At Duke, Lukić would join another loaded recruiting class that includes Asa Montgomery, Luke Paul and Kager Kneuppel. 
 Duke coach Jon Scheyer was also in recently to see five-star Class of 2029 Prolific Prep (FL) wing Draydne McDaniel .
